provenance.notes: Datasheet: Vishay General Semiconductor 1N4001 to 1N4007, document 88503, revision 29-Apr-2020 (5 pages), 1N4007 column. MAXIMUM RATINGS p.1: VRRM 1000 V, VRMS 700 V, VDC 1000 V, IF(AV) 1.0 A (0.375 in leads, TA 75 °C), IFSM 30 A (8.3 ms half sine). ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS p.2: maximum instantaneous VF 1.1 V at 1.0 A (a maximum, not a typical); maximum DC reverse current IR 5.0 µA at 25 °C and 50 µA at 125 °C at rated blocking voltage; typical junction capacitance 15 pF at 4.0 V, 1 MHz. Polarity: 'color band denotes cathode end'. vfTypFig4V 0.92 V is NOT a table value: it is read by eye from the typical forward characteristic Fig. 4 p.3 (TJ 25 °C, 300 µs pulses) at 1 A, good to about ±0.03 V, and is there because fitting a Shockley model to the 1.1 V maximum would overstate the drop by about 0.2 V. The same curve passes about 0.6 V at 10 mA and about 0.8 V at 0.2 A. Package outline p.4 (DO-41): body ø2.0 to 2.7 mm, length 4.1 to 5.2 mm, lead ø0.71 to 0.86 mm (0.58 to 0.66 mm for E-suffix parts), leads 25.4 mm min; bodyMm uses the maxima. Kit: 1N4007 x2 on the component list image. Spans: minSpan 1 is an upright mount (ø2.7 max body over one hole); a flat mount needs hole spacing above the 5.2 mm body, so at least 3 pitches. maxSpan 15 = floor((5.2 + 2 x (25.4 - 8)) / 2.54); the 8 mm per lead bend/insertion allowance is a modelling assumption, not a datasheet value.
